cases.prompt: /discover A lightweight approval product for small creative agencies. Turn the idea into the smallest evidence-backed MVP and roadmap without inventing market facts.
/design A flagship Persian-language personal-finance onboarding journey for first-time investors. It must feel calm and credible, not like a crypto dashboard. Create the accepted direction only.

/build-ui Create a self-contained, functional Persian RTL onboarding slice under eval-output/rtl-finance using platform HTML/CSS/JS. Include realistic validation, success and error states, one justified signature interaction, reduced motion, and browser evidence.

/build-ui Create a self-contained operations exception queue under eval-output/ops-queue. It must help dispatchers resolve delayed shipments quickly with dense realistic data, keyboard operation, loading/empty/error states, and a visual language grounded in logistics rather than generic cards.

/design-review Review any rendered UI under eval-output. If none exists, inspect the design contract and clearly mark rendered criteria unproven. Be strict about interchangeable AI-design defaults and do not edit files.

/spec A modal looks polished but traps mouse users correctly while keyboard focus escapes behind it and errors are announced only by color. Specify the smallest production fix and proof without redesigning the product.
/spec A billing table works at 1440px but clips localized plan names and action menus at 320px and 200% text zoom. Define behavior and evidence while preserving data meaning.
/spec A new visual hero introduces a 4MB image, late font swap, and scroll animation. Define a measurable optimization contract that preserves the design thesis.
grade: covers LCP CLS and input cost
preserves reduced motion and visual intent

cases.prompt: /build Diagnose and fix a hypothetical repeated-submit bug only if repository evidence contains a reproduction. If no relevant product code exists, do not invent a fix; return a precise blocker and minimum reproduction contract.
/spec Users can rename a workspace by sending its ID. Specify a secure contract assuming the client can tamper with role and workspace IDs.
/spec A payment callback can arrive late, duplicated, reordered, or replayed. Specify the smallest safe state transition and evidence contract.
/adr Decide whether a generic template should add a second frontend framework for one planned screen. Use repository evidence and record a decision only if justified.
/handoff Create a clean handoff only if an active execution plan and real partial work exist. Do not manufacture progress from the benchmark prompt.

/design-review Assume the local app or browser cannot start only if actual evidence shows that. Distinguish failed, blocked, skipped, and unproven checks and give the cheapest discriminating next action.
/release-plan Define a staged release for a new user-facing product with unknown traffic and no proven rollback. Do not deploy. Include a realistic path for incident learning.
